verified_dependency_structure.D: compute_D_loss reads netD, the detached generated endpoint, real_B and time_idx; it does not read netE parameters.
verified_dependency_structure.E: compute_E_loss reads netE and detached endpoint pairs; it does not read netD parameters, so committing D before E does not change the E loss represented by the saved DE views.
verified_dependency_structure.GF: compute_G_loss reads the post-commit netD/netE state and differentiable G/F quantities. PC-RSMG creates a new two-view GF bundle only after D and E have committed.
verified_dependency_structure.official_batch: All replicas retain the same official batch-1 real_A/real_B and independently redraw only the native forward/loss stochastic variables; replicas are never concatenated into a larger image batch or PatchNCE negative pool.

mathematical_claim_that_is_supported.conditioning: Condition on the official unpaired batch and the realized network/optimizer state at which each player gradient is evaluated.
mathematical_claim_that_is_supported.D_and_E: Each committed gradient is the arithmetic mean of two iid native-measure gradient samples. Linearity therefore preserves the conditional mean gradient and halves ideal conditional trace variance.
mathematical_claim_that_is_supported.GF: The GF views are generated after the realized D/E commits and are independent of the DE estimator under the modeled iid random measure. Their mean is therefore unbiased for the GF loss-gradient field at that realized post-opponent state.
mathematical_claim_that_is_supported.stationarity: The expected per-player loss-gradient fields and their zeros are preserved; the algorithm changes their conditional covariance and cross-player finite-step noise coupling.

claims_explicitly_not_supported: The expected Adam parameter step is identical to plain; Adam is nonlinear in the sampled gradient and its moments.
The exact finite-learning-rate stochastic transition is identical to plain; PC-RSMG intentionally redraws GF randomness after D/E and changes cross-player covariance.
The stateful pseudorandom stream is byte-equivalent at two replicas; only pcrsmg_replicates=1 has exact plain identity.
Variance reduction alone guarantees PSNR improvement, e200 benefit, seed stability or cross-runtime stability.
The current e60 signal is a final candidate result.

rng_and_loss_sampling_boundary.observation: The implementation creates both forward views before evaluating their loss-specific randomness, so the exact RNG ordering differs from two serial native optimize calls.
rng_and_loss_sampling_boundary.interpretation: Under the registered iid stochastic-measure model this is distributionally valid because the forward and loss draws remain distinct native random draws. It is not an exact seeded-transition equivalence claim.
rng_and_loss_sampling_boundary.resume_requirement: Full CPU/CUDA/Python/NumPy RNG plus method bundle counters are checkpointed; the two-update resume gate was exact on both accelerators.
